q: 1. The space required for living the worker is 15m³ with considering the maximum height of room above floor level.
explain: For health and volumetric space calculations per worker, room heights above 4 meters are generally not factored in to ensure effective breathing space.

q: 2. According to FAR, the project manager has authority to approve the variation upto
explain: Under the FIDIC/FAR-based contract administration norms used in Nepal, the project manager is generally authorized to approve variations up to 10% of the contract value.

q: 3. The maximum height of boundary wall is limited to ........
explain: As per the answer key, the boundary wall height limit is 4 feet.
